points_of_no_return.effect: Completing this quest takes Geralt from White Orchard to Vizima. White Orchard cannot be revisited afterwards (until a late story visit), so its open side quests fail.
Vesemir dies during the battle. Anything that needs him, such as winning his Gwent card, is lost afterwards.
The game shows a point-of-no-return warning before the final act. Many open secondary quests can no longer be completed afterwards.
